summary: Not safe to merge yet. calculate_discount now raises ValueError for expired coupons instead of returning 0, and two callers do not handle it: checkout will crash and subscription renewals will fail. The migration also renames a column that coupon_repo.py still queries.

reasons: Behavior change in a function with 3 direct callers, 2 of which break.
Existing test test_total_with_expired_coupon fails on this branch.
Column coupons.expires_at is renamed but still referenced in code.
pricing.py had 3 bug-fix commits in the last 180 days.

changes.description: Expired coupons now raise ValueError("Coupon has expired"). Before, the function returned 0.
Column renamed to valid_until, plus a new index created without CONCURRENTLY.

callers.reason: Calls calculate_discount without handling ValueError, so checkout with an expired coupon raises instead of charging full price.
Already wraps the call in try/except ValueError and falls back to a zero discount.
No error handling; one expired coupon stops run_renewals for every subscription after it. Confirmed by a generated test.

schema_changes.description: CREATE INDEX on coupons without CONCURRENTLY may lock the table during deploy.

missing_coverage.description: No test covered subscription renewal with an expired coupon.

generated_test.note: run_renewals raised ValueError: Coupon has expired.

suggested_fixes: Catch ValueError in OrderService.total and charge the full price, or keep returning 0 from calculate_discount and add a separate is_expired check.
Handle expired coupons per subscription in renew so one bad coupon does not stop the whole renewal run.
Update coupon_repo.find_active to use valid_until in the same release as the migration.
Create the index with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY.

agent_trace.detail: 1 changed function, 3 direct callers, 1 renamed column, 3 tests selected out of 5.
Return 0 replaced by raise ValueError: behavior change, not a refactor.
build_invoice handles ValueError; OrderService.total and renew do not.
coupon_repo.py still uses the old column name.
